title: Hereticon talk: flood myths rooted in real floods

tellings.quote: Was that behind the flood myths from all over the world there have been really there have been real floods that were really big really huge could be described as biblical in scale.

plain: The flood stories told all over the world, like the one in the Bible, go back to real floods that were "really huge" and "biblical in scale." That was the argument of a talk at Hereticon, a conference for unorthodox ideas, as the researcher Randall Carlson describes it to Michels without naming the speaker or a source. If it is true, those old myths would be memories of real disasters, not inventions.
